mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a foggy 61 degrees near the Verona Public Library. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and if you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible for five minutes starting at 4:55 AM. Watch it rise in the southwest over Mount Horeb and track across the sky toward the east northeast near Fitchburg.

The City of Verona is prioritizing better connectivity with its sidewalk and multi-use path policy. This ensures that as we reconstruct roads like Mark Drive, we are also installing new sidewalks to help kids, seniors, and all residents move safely throughout the community. Meanwhile, annual street rehabilitation projects are moving forward to restore our pavement quality.

Today is packed with activities including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or join the fun at Hop Haus trivia.

On Friday, August 15, Verona officers responded to a concerning call where a 44-year-old woman was found unresponsive behind the wheel of her vehicle. After police were able to wake her, she attempted to continue driving and was subsequently arrested for a first offence O W I.
Today's featured flavor is the refreshing Double Strawberry. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
